purpose: Hold-out, supplied-transcript path: F10, a silent screen capture with a sidecar transcript whose cue times need an explicit offset. No earlier round used F10 or asked about its dialog; the skill, grader and help text were not tuned on it.

phases.prompt: This recording, {{video}}, is a short screen capture of a dialog check. Its sidecar transcript, {{transcript}}, has cue times that are early by the offset {{offset_us}} microseconds. Tell me which dialog is shown and what the sidecar says about its own timing. Use the VSift skill and the compact budget. When you have written the handoff, keep the evidence: I authorise you to retain the session to a new folder named {{bundle_dir}} in this directory with vsift session retain (without the video), and then leave the session open.
